What these measurements can tell you

Short-time Fourier transforms describe how frequency energy changes over time. Brightness is a spectral summary; a peak is not necessarily a musical note. These measurements cannot identify a pain-relieving frequency, a diagnosis, or the cause of comfort.

Analyze a clip to see the sampling details.

For binaural audio, the left and right channels matter. A microphone recording in a room does not preserve the separate signal reaching each ear.
